description: This Dart source file contains the implementation of a Tic Tac Toe game, including the game logic, move validation, winner detection, draw detection, and an AI opponent using minimax with heuristics.

classes.name: Player
classes.description: An enumeration representing players in the game: X, O, or None for empty cell.

classes.name: TicTacToeGame
classes.description: A class encapsulating the game state, including the board, current player, move logic, winner checking, and AI move calculation.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Attempts to place the current player's mark on the specified cell if it is empty.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game board to an initial empty state and sets the current player to X.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks current board state for a winner and returns the Player who won or Player.none if there is no winner.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game is a draw (full board with no winner).

methods.name: bestMove
methods.description: Calculates the best move for the specified AI player using minimax algorithm with depth limit.

methods.name: _minimax
methods.description: Internal recursive function implementing minimax algorithm with depth limit and heuristics.

methods.name: _heuristic
methods.description: Heuristic evaluation of board potential lines to assist AI move decisions.
